what_it_is.prose: Collins Aerospace, a business of RTX Corporation, is a US OEM of avionics, mission systems, cabin interiors, propeller systems and power & controls. Its products are embedded across Western platforms operated by India — including the C-130J, C-295 and P-8I — but as a diffuse subsystem supplier rather than a prime, and India-specific defence order values are not consolidated in public sources. Collins does maintain a genuine India engineering footprint through Global Capability Centres in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, including a new Bengaluru engineering/manufacturing site. Recorded here as an honest Tier C supplier card pending discrete, citable India programme data.
